Sou Mário Serafim, diretor de arte. Trab: I'm Mário Serafim, an art director. I work across visual identities, campaigns and digital experiences. I like brands with something to say, and finding a way to say it without making them look like everyone else.
Cada projeto pede um olhar diferente. Ai: Every project calls for a different eye. Good thing. Imagine spending your whole life swapping logos and changing button colours.
Uma marca precisa funcionar na vida real: A brand has to work in real life: on a website, in a campaign, on packaging, even in that piece someone needed yesterday. My job is to make it all work together without losing the identity along the way.
Não é só criar um símbolo e torcer pra d: It takes more than a symbol and a hope for the best. It takes a visual language people can recognise wherever the brand shows up.
Antes de decidir como a marca vai aparec: Before deciding how a brand should look, we need to figure out what it has to say. Skipping that step sounds like a time-saver. It rarely is.
Campanhas, imagens e peças que conversam: Campaigns, images and pieces that work together. Giving every post a new personality isn't a strategy.
Um site pode ser bonito, mas, se ninguém: A site can look great, but if no one knows where to click, something went wrong. I like interfaces where identity and experience work together.
O que sua marca precisa resolver? Com qu: What does your brand need to solve? Who does it want to talk to? What's working already, and what's getting in the way?
